about: 2026-11 — the orchestra lists of the night's shape, in one place (they were written out in compose.ts, Composer.tsx, djMessage.ts, buildGuide.ts and editCheck.ts). Read by packages/core/src/nightShape.ts and re-exported to the web. bigFour: the short name a DJ reads for each of the big four (the rule itself is coherence.ts BIG_FOUR). cumparsitaPreferred: the orchestras whose La Cumparsita closes the night first (×weight in compose.ts). ultimaPool: corpus rule 15, the orchestras of the última; ultimaInstrumentalOk: those whose instrumental tanda may close. openerChoices / ultimaChoices: the Composer's 'Opens with' and 'Última' pickers (key orchestra|singer: '~' instrumental, '*' any voice; labelKey: an i18n key instead of a name).
